translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.75:1: I do swear by the Day of Judgment
verses.75:2: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul
verses.75:3: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones
verses.75:4: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips
verses.75:5: Still people want to deny what is yet to come
verses.75:6: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
verses.75:7: But when the sight is stunned
verses.75:9: and the sun and the moon are brought together
verses.75:10: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”
verses.75:11: But no! There will be no refuge
verses.75:12: On that Day all will end up before your Lord
verses.75:13: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind
verses.75:14: In fact, people will testify against their own souls
verses.75:15: despite the excuses they come up with
verses.75:16: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran
verses.75:17: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it
verses.75:18: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺
verses.75:19: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺
verses.75:20: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world
verses.75:22: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright
verses.75:25: anticipating something devastating to befall them
verses.75:26: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺
verses.75:27: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”
verses.75:28: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart
verses.75:29: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺
verses.75:30: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺
verses.75:31: This denier neither believed nor prayed
verses.75:32: but persisted in denial and turned away
verses.75:33: then went to their own people, walking boastfully
verses.75:34: Woe to you, and more woe
verses.75:35: Again, woe to you, and even more woe
verses.75:36: Do people think they will be left without purpose
verses.75:37: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted
verses.75:38: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form
verses.75:39: producing from it both sexes, male and female
verses.75:40: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life
